facts.text: For students admitted into a Massachusetts state school and awarded the Mass Grant Free Tuition Award, Western New England University matches the award to cover full tuition and fees.

sources.title: Undergraduate Cost & Aid - Western New England University
sources.quote: for students who are admitted into one of the Massachusetts state schools and awarded the Mass Grant Free Tuition Award, we will match that award to cover full tuition and fees at Western New England University.
